content_sections.heading: CSB Sericulture Assistant Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Desirable Qualification: Work experience in the field of silkworm rearing & grainage/ Sericulture and related field (Pre-Cocoon Sector).

rows.qualification_required: Three years full time degree in Sericulture OR Four years full time degree in Sericulture OR Three years full time degree + PG Diploma in Sericulture OR Four years full time bachelor degree in Agriculture Sciences/Forestry OR Three years full time degree in Biological Sciences (Zoology or Botany or Biology)/Biotechnology + PG diploma in Sericulture OR Three years full time bachelor degree in Biology Sciences (Zoology or Botany or Biology)/Biotechnology + one year experience in Sericultural project work

content_sections.heading: CSB Sericulture Assistant Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary and contractual, initially for a period not exceeding one (1) year. The engagement does not confer any right for regularisation, absorption, continuation, or claim for permanent appointment in CSB. Candidates should bring their original certificates and identity proof for verification at the time of the interview. The date, time, and venue of the personal interview will be intimated to eligible candidates through email only. Canvassing directly or indirectly will disqualify the candidate's candidature. Candidates opting for the place of posting are preferably expected to be well-versed in the local language of the concerned region.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the CSB Sericulture Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Central Silk Board, Muga Eri Silkworm Seed Organization.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 16 vacancies available for the Sericulture Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of application is 30.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for CSB Sericulture Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a three or four-year full-time degree in Sericulture, Agriculture Sciences/Forestry, or Biological Sciences (Zoology, Botany, Biology)/Biotechnology with required PG diploma or project experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as of 06.11.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Sericulture Assistant?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 21,000/- + HRA per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection will be based solely on the performance of eligible candidates in the personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this engagement is purely contractual for an initial period of one year and does not confer any right for regularisation or permanent appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official portal at https://csb-hiring.in/.
